trigger: POST /api/v1/inventory/evaluate's new openapi_spec() entry documented combine as enum ["and","or"] default "and" and op as ["eq","neq","gt","lt","gte","lte","contains"]; evaluate_inventory()/eval_condition() (inventory_eval.cpp) only recognize the literal "any" for OR (everything else including the documented "or" means AND) and only recognize ==,!=,contains,exists,version_gte,version_lte,>=,<=,>,< for op (none of the documented op tokens match, so every condition with a documented value silently fails to match)

classification_rationale: openapi_spec()'s documented request schema directly contradicts the accepting code's actual behaviour.
